T: Welcome to Fright Night. Bring garlic.
D: A teenager is convinced the new neighbour is a vampire, and nobody believes him.
P: Serve the snacks when Peter Vincent's late night TV show starts.
S: Peter Vincent's horror show on the telly
Popcorn tossed in melted butter, fine salt and a little smoked paprika, served in a big bowl in front of the TV.
Baguette split, spread with butter mashed with lots of raw garlic, parsley and salt, wrapped in foil, baked at 200C for 12 minutes, then opened for 3 to crisp.
the neighbour is always eating an apple
Crisp red apples sliced and tossed in lemon, with a dip of peanut butter whipped with honey and a pinch of salt, or salted caramel.
M: enough garlic to keep Jerry out
Chicken thighs browned skin side down, forty unpeeled garlic cloves, thyme and white wine added, covered and baked at 180C for an hour. Squeeze the garlic onto crusty bread.
the club where Jerry dances with Amy
Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, cheddar melted on top, caramelised onion and pickles on soft slider buns, wrapped in paper.
W: blood red, but Jerry won't touch it
Silky set cream sharpened with blood orange juice, served cold in little glasses with a sliver of candied peel.
K: fill the little bottles before the neighbour visits
Lemonade with fresh lime over ice, served in small glass bottles.

s.how: Mash 100g soft butter with 5 crushed raw garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt. Split a baguette, spread thickly, wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Open the foil for the last 3 minutes to crisp.

s.note: the neighbour is always eating an apple
s.how: Slice 3 red apples and toss in lemon juice. Whip 150g peanut butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt until light. Fan the apples around the dip. Don't invite anyone in without checking first.

m.note: enough garlic to keep Jerry out
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs skin side down. Add 40 unpeeled garlic cloves, thyme and 200ml white wine. Cover and bake at 180C for an hour. Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of crusty bread and eat with the chicken.

w.note: blood red, but Jerry won't touch it
w.how: Bring 600ml thickened cream and 150g caster sugar to the boil and simmer 3 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in 120ml blood orange juice and the zest of 1 blood orange. Pour into 4 glasses and chill at least 4 hours until set. Top with thin slices of blood orange to serve.

d.note: fill the little bottles before the neighbour visits
d.how: Squeeze 2 limes into 1.25L cold lemonade. Pour over ice into four small glass bottles. Keep one by the front door for the neighbour, just in case.
